candidates.label: Divine command imminence removing human impatience
candidates.definition: In 16:1: The command of Allah is coming so be not impatient for it; Exalted is He above what they associate.

evidence.excerpt: أَتَىٰٓ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوهُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

candidates.label: Angelic inspiration as warning mechanism establishing tawheed
candidates.definition: In 16:2: He sends down angels with inspiration of His command upon whom He wills saying warn there is no deity except Me so fear Him.

evidence.excerpt: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Wahy through malak as warning delivery.
La ilaha illa Ana as core message.

candidates.label: Comprehensive livestock blessing catalog spanning multiple utilities
candidates.definition: In 16:5-8: Grazing livestock provide warmth benefits food beauty transport; horses mules donkeys for riding and adornment.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَاۖ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا دِفۡءٞ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

candidates.label: Celestial subjection enabling navigation and timekeeping
candidates.definition: In 16:12: He subjected night day sun moon stars subjected by His command; indeed in that are signs for people who reason.

evidence.excerpt: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتُۢ بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ

candidates.label: Rain-vegetation cycle as agricultural provision system
candidates.definition: In 16:10-11: He sends down rain from sky producing drink and foliage for pasturing; grows crops olives palms grapevines fruits.

evidence.excerpt: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗۖ لَّكُم مِّنۡهُ شَرَابٞ وَمِنۡهُ شَجَرٞ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ

candidates.label: Maritime commerce enabled by divine sea subjection
candidates.definition: In 16:14: He subjected sea to eat fresh meat extract ornaments wear ships plowing through it seeking His bounty.

evidence.excerpt: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَأۡكُلُواْ مِنۡهُ لَحۡمٗا طَرِيّٗا وَتَسۡتَخۡرِجُواْ مِنۡهُ حِلۡيَةٗ تَلۡبَسُونَهَاۖ وَتَرَى ٱلۡفُلۡكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

candidates.label: Mountain stabilization as geological mercy preventing earthquakes
candidates.definition: In 16:15: He cast firmly set mountains on earth lest it shift with you; rivers roads landmarks; by stars they are guided.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمۡ وَأَنۡهَٰرٗا وَسُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ

candidates.label: Uncountable divine favors establishing perpetual indebtedness
candidates.definition: In 16:18: If you should count the favors of Allah you could not enumerate them; indeed mankind is most unjust ungrateful.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

candidates.label: Human origin from sperm-drop contrasting adversarial posture
candidates.definition: In 16:4: He created man from a sperm-drop then at once he is a clear adversary.

evidence.excerpt: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ

candidates.label: Creation in truth negating purposeless existence and shirk
candidates.definition: In 16:3: He created heavens and earth in truth; Exalted is He above what they associate.

evidence.excerpt: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

candidates.label: Polytheist determinism excuse refuted by prior messenger evidence
candidates.definition: In 16:35: Polytheists say if Allah willed we would not have worshipped besides Him nor our fathers nor forbidden anything; thus did those before them.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا عَبَدۡنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَيۡءٖ نَّحۡنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمۡنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ فَهَلۡ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

candidates.label: Universal messenger pattern with bifurcated guidance outcome
candidates.definition: In 16:36: We sent to every nation a messenger worship Allah avoid taghut; among them were guided and among them were justly misled.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ بَعَثۡنَا فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٖ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجۡتَنِبُواْ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ حَقَّتۡ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةُۚ فَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

candidates.label: Observational command to study historical consequences of denial
candidates.definition: In 16:36: So travel through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ بَعَثۡنَا فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٖ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجۡتَنِبُواْ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ حَقَّتۡ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةُۚ فَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

candidates.label: Book revealed as clarification-guidance-mercy triad
candidates.definition: In 16:64: We have not revealed to you the Book except to make clear to them that wherein they differ and as guidance and mercy for people who believe.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي ٱخۡتَلَفُواْ فِيهِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

candidates.label: Idol incapacity demonstrated through creation-inability
candidates.definition: In 16:20-21: Those invoked besides Allah create nothing and are themselves created; dead not alive not perceiving when resurrected.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخۡلُقُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُونَ

candidates.label: Migration-persecution-patience sequence with divine forgiveness
candidates.definition: In 16:110: Then indeed your Lord to those who migrated after being persecuted then fought and were patient — your Lord thereafter is Forgiving Merciful.

evidence.excerpt: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا فُتِنُواْ ثُمَّ جَٰهَدُواْ وَصَبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهَا لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

candidates.label: Satanic beautification of deeds as counter-revelation mechanism
candidates.definition: In 16:63: Satan made their deeds attractive to them so he is their ally today and for them is painful punishment.

evidence.excerpt: تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

candidates.label: Consultation command directing to people of remembrance
candidates.definition: In 16:43: Ask the people of remembrance (ahl al-dhikr) if you do not know.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالٗا نُّوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡۖ فَسۡـَٔلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلذِّكۡرِ إِن كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Su'al ahl al-dhikr as knowledge method.

candidates.label: Slave-free parable demonstrating inequality of created versus Creator
candidates.definition: In 16:75: Allah strikes example: slave owned unable over anything versus one provided good spending secretly openly — are they equal?

evidence.excerpt: ۞ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبۡدٗا مَّمۡلُوكٗا لَّا يَقۡدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ وَمَن رَّزَقۡنَٰهُ مِنَّا رِزۡقًا حَسَنٗا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنۡهُ سِرّٗا وَجَهۡرًاۖ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوُۥنَۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

candidates.label: Divine oath affirming resurrection against persistent denial
candidates.definition: In 16:38: They swore by Allah most solemn oaths Allah will not raise one who dies; rather it is a binding promise upon Him.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَقۡسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ جَهۡدَ أَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ لَا يَبۡعَثُ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُۚ بَلَىٰ وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡهِ حَقّٗا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

candidates.label: Bee revelation producing multi-colored healing drink as natural sign
candidates.definition: In 16:68-69: Your Lord inspired the bee take houses in mountains trees; eat from all fruits follow ways of Lord; emerges from bellies drink varying colors in it healing for people.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَوۡحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحۡلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِي مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتٗا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعۡرِشُونَ

candidates.label: Livestock milk production spanning digestive physiology as biological sign
candidates.definition: In 16:66: Indeed for you in grazing livestock is a lesson; We give you drink from what is in their bellies between excretion and blood pure milk pleasant for drinkers.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ لَعِبۡرَةٗۖ نُّسۡقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهِۦ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ فَرۡثٖ وَدَمٖ لَّبَنًا خَالِصٗا سَآئِغٗا لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ

candidates.label: Halal-haram dietary framework with necessity exception
candidates.definition: In 16:115: He has only forbidden dead meat blood flesh of swine dedicated to other than Allah; whoever is forced not transgressing nor sinning Allah is Forgiving Merciful.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةَ وَٱلدَّمَ وَلَحۡمَ ٱلۡخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيۡرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦۖ فَمَنِ ٱضۡطُرَّ غَيۡرَ بَاغٖ وَلَا عَادٖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Maytah dam lahm khinzir ma uhilla.

candidates.label: Gratitude linked to worship as integrated devotion
candidates.definition: In 16:114: Eat from what Allah provided lawful good and be grateful for Allah's favor if it is Him you worship.

evidence.excerpt: فَكُلُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ حَلَٰلٗا طَيِّبٗا وَٱشۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ إِيَّاهُ تَعۡبُدُونَ

candidates.label: Town security-to-punishment narrative as gratitude-ingratitude paradigm
candidates.definition: In 16:112-113: Town secure abundant provision became ungrateful for Allah's favors; tasted garment of hunger and fear because of what they used to do.

evidence.excerpt: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا قَرۡيَةٗ كَانَتۡ ءَامِنَةٗ مُّطۡمَئِنَّةٗ يَأۡتِيهَا رِزۡقُهَا رَغَدٗا مِّن كُلِّ مَكَانٖ فَكَفَرَتۡ بِأَنۡعُمِ ٱللَّهِ فَأَذَٰقَهَا ٱللَّهُ لِبَاسَ ٱلۡجُوعِ وَٱلۡخَوۡفِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَصۡنَعُونَ

candidates.label: Human lifecycle reversal demonstrating divine knowledge-power
candidates.definition: In 16:70: Allah created you then takes you in death; among you reversed to most decrepit age knowing nothing after having known.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمۡۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرۡذَلِ ٱلۡعُمُرِ لِكَيۡ لَا يَعۡلَمَ بَعۡدَ عِلۡمٖ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٞ قَدِيرٞ

candidates.label: Lying fabrication against Allah producing brief enjoyment then severe punishment
candidates.definition: In 16:116-117: Do not invent lies against Allah saying this is lawful this is forbidden; those who fabricate enjoy briefly then have painful punishment.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَقُولُواْ لِمَا تَصِفُ أَلۡسِنَتُكُمُ ٱلۡكَذِبَ هَٰذَا حَلَٰلٞ وَهَٰذَا حَرَامٞ لِّتَفۡتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفۡتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَ لَا يُفۡلِحُونَ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Iftira' ala Allah as supreme falsehood.
Brief enjoyment followed by lasting penalty.

candidates.label: Jewish dietary restrictions as punitive measure for transgression
candidates.definition: In 16:118: To those who are Jews We forbade what We related to you before; We did not wrong them but they used to wrong themselves.

evidence.excerpt: وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُواْ حَرَّمۡنَا مَا قَصَصۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ

candidates.label: Spousal-progeny-provision triad as social blessing requiring recognition
candidates.definition: In 16:72: Allah made for you spouses from yourselves produced sons grandchildren provided good things; in falsehood believe in favor deny?

evidence.excerpt: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةٗ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِۚ أَفَبِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُونَ وَبِنِعۡمَتِ ٱللَّهِ هُمۡ يَكۡفُرُونَ

candidates.label: Rain-revival as resurrection microcosm accessible to observation
candidates.definition: In 16:65: Allah sent down rain from sky given life to earth after lifelessness; indeed in that is sign for people who listen.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَآۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَسۡمَعُونَ

candidates.label: Quran recitation preceded by isti'adha establishing spiritual protection
candidates.definition: In 16:98: When you recite the Quran seek refuge in Allah from Satan the expelled.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِذَا قَرَأۡتَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ فَٱسۡتَعِذۡ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ

candidates.label: Satanic powerlessness against trusting believers
candidates.definition: In 16:99: Indeed he has no authority over those who believed and upon their Lord rely.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّهُۥ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ سُلۡطَٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

candidates.label: Prophetic methodology: wisdom good instruction best argumentation
candidates.definition: In 16:125: Invite to way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction and argue with them in way that is best.

evidence.excerpt: ٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَٱلۡمَوۡعِظَةِ ٱلۡحَسَنَةِۖ وَجَٰدِلۡهُم بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ

candidates.label: Proportional retaliation with patience preference
candidates.definition: In 16:126: If you punish punish with equivalent of what you were harmed; but if you are patient it is better for the patient.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِنۡ عَاقَبۡتُمۡ فَعَاقِبُواْ بِمِثۡلِ مَا عُوقِبۡتُم بِهِۦۖ وَلَئِن صَبَرۡتُمۡ لَهُوَ خَيۡرٞ لِّلصَّـٰبِرِينَ

candidates.label: Abraham as millat Ibrahim prototype defining prophetic identity
candidates.definition: In 16:120-123: Abraham was ummah qanit hanif not of mushrikin grateful for favors chosen guided straight path; revealed to you follow millat Ibrahim.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ كَانَ أُمَّةٗ قَانِتٗا لِّلَّهِ حَنِيفٗا وَلَمۡ يَكُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ

candidates.label: Patience sourced exclusively through divine enablement
candidates.definition: In 16:127: Be patient and your patience is not but through Allah; do not grieve over them nor be in distress from what they plot.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱصۡبِرۡ وَمَا صَبۡرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِۚ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضَيۡقٖ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُونَ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Ma sabruka illa billah as divine dependency.

candidates.label: Divine companionship promise for muttaqin and muhsinin
candidates.definition: In 16:128: Indeed Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّٱلَّذِينَ هُم مُّحۡسِنُونَ

candidates.label: Verse replacement acknowledged within divine knowledge framework
candidates.definition: In 16:101: When We replace a verse in place of another verse Allah knows best what He reveals; they say you are inventing.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا بَدَّلۡنَآ ءَايَةٗ مَّكَانَ ءَايَةٖ وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُفۡتَرِۭۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

candidates.label: Foreign-language objection answered by Arabic clarity
candidates.definition: In 16:103: We know they say he teaches him; tongue of one they refer to is foreign and this is clear Arabic language.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ أَنَّهُمۡ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُۥ بَشَرٞۗ لِّسَانُ ٱلَّذِي يُلۡحِدُونَ إِلَيۡهِ أَعۡجَمِيّٞ وَهَٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيّٞ مُّبِينٌ

candidates.label: Faith increase under persecution with divine forgiveness-mercy response
candidates.definition: In 16:110: Those who migrated after trial then fought and were patient — your Lord thereafter is Forgiving Merciful.

evidence.excerpt: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا فُتِنُواْ ثُمَّ جَٰهَدُواْ وَصَبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهَا لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
